notes.title: Take part in the game's crowdfunding campaign!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, there is only one week left until the end of the crowdfunding campaign for the production of [b][i]The Girl Who Wasn't There[/i][/b]. We haven't reached the necessary backers yet but, with your help, we are still on time to reach the goal. Please help us to make this game a reality with the quality that the project deserves.

A reminder that you can now download our demo with the prologue of the story to experience the beginning of Ranko's new adventure. You can access the campaign by clicking on the following banner.

notes.title: The Girl Who Wasn't There Demo available now!
notes.notes:
[b][i]The Girl Who Wasn't There[/i][/b] demo has finally arrived on Steam! Experience the story's prologue and find out how Ranko and Astrid's new case begins at St. Joachim's Academy.

As you can see, the game has changed a lot from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673560/Murder_on_the_Marine_Express/][i]Murder on the Marine Express[/i][/url]. Character design is in the capable hands of [b]Izucchi[/b], a Tokyo-based illustrator who specializes in concept and design for publishing and audiovisual products. On the other hand, background art is by [b]Frogapples[/b], a hyper talented artist from the Philippines who is an expert in making pixel art illustrations. Last but not least,  there's [b]Saria Lemes[/b]: a Brazilian composer who specializes in chiptune and VGM soundtracks, and is a prominent member of the retro-style music scene.

We take this opportunity to remind you that [b]we launched a crowdfunding campaign on Kickstarter[/b], which aims to raise the necessary funds to cover the remaining production of the game. If you decide to support us, you'll be able to get the game at a lower price and also some interesting extras like the soundtrack or a digital artbook. We even have [u]a special edition for physical lovers[/u]! You can find the campaign at this [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/240607722/the-girl-who-wasnt-there-0]link[/url].

All those who contribute with their donation will have access to an early version with the first two routes of the game, so that they can test the adventure before the official release. This version will be automatically updated once the final development of the game is completed. Therefore, changes may occur between this first version and the final one, and any achievements present in the final version will not be applied yet.

We recommend following our social media ([url=https://x.com/1564Studio]@1564 Studio[/url]) to be up to date with any news regarding the development and additions to [b][i]The Girl Who Wasn't There[/i][/b]. Download the demo today and enjoy the new mystery we are preparing!
